findings.label: OAuth state TTL unit ambiguity
findings.detail: redisCacheService.putString(key, uri, 10) uses putString(String,String,int ttlMinutes) so OAuth state lives 10 minutes, but surrounding comments say '10' without a unit. Cosmetic; consider noting 'minutes'.

findings.label: Demo OAuth requires external console registration
findings.detail: Google/Microsoft demo callback URLs must be registered in the provider consoles or demo OAuth fails with redirect_uri_mismatch. Correctly out-of-code and documented in GoogleOAuthService/MicrosoftOAuthService comments and plan.md; no code action.
